_about: Starter profile for the owner numbers (worksheet docs/01-PRODUCT-REQUIREMENTS/08), built for Rp 50,000. PROPOSED by the engineering agent at the owner's request on 2026-11-16, not decided: nothing here is applied to any instance. At this size the exchange minimum order forces a larger risk per trade than the Rp 1,000,000 profile (see the profile document). Edit the values, then run: python deploy/trader/check_owner_defaults.py <this file>

decision.scope: all values as written, chosen over the Rp 1,000,000 profile in a multiple-choice answer
decision.paper_costs: revised 2026-11-19 from the owner's own Indodax account screen (IDR market, PRO): buy = service fee 0.1% (maker) or 0.2% (taker) + bourse fee 0.00555%, tax 0%; sell = the same + tax 0.21%. So tax_pct 0.21 is charged on sales only and clearing_pct 0.00555 is the bourse fee (ADR-060). This replaces the placeholders 0.25 and 0.05; OQ-5 is answered for the IDR market
decision.applied: the first version was applied by the owner on 2026-11-18; the revised paper costs are not applied until the owner runs import_owner_profile.py again, dry run first, then --apply (lowering costs asks for the password)

basis.risk_profile: small account: risk per trade is set by the exchange minimum, not by preference
basis.min_order_note: OBSERVED 2026-11-17 from the public GET /api/pairs (no key, no signature): BTCIDR and ETHIDR both have trade_min_base_currency 10000 IDR (trade_min_traded_currency 8.36e-06 BTC and 0.00029667 ETH, about the same 10000 IDR). The 5% stop distance is still an assumption

observed.source: public GET /api/summaries, 3 samples 10 s apart (no key, no signature)
observed.note: the spread is one price tick (Rp 1,000) on both pairs, so it cannot be narrower; one 20-second window says nothing about stressed hours
